results.title: Mighty Cursor: Talk to your cursor-Get instant answers right where you are. | Product Hunt
results.content:
could we make interacting with AI more human, more seamless, using voice? I was lucky to connect with a full stack developer Arul, who shared the same vision. Together, navigating many challenges, we’ve worked to make Mighty Cursor intuitive and, hopefully, a delight to use. MC isn't just another app; it's a rethink of how we interact with AI – making it seamless and intuitive right where you are. (Quick note: MC has no relation to the coding assistant with a similar name!) Imagine this: 🤯 Instantly clarify confusing text, summarize articles, or generate content right where you are, without ever leaving your current application. 🎙️ Just press and hold a hotkey, ask your question, and release to get an answer via voice or text. It’s like having a walkie-talkie to an AI that understands [...] It’s like having a walkie-talkie to an AI that understands text, images, webpages, and even documents. 💡 Smart Output: MC is clever about how it responds! Ask a general knowledge question (who/what/when etc.), and it replies by voice. Ask it to write something, and it pastes the response directly into your active document. ⚡ Boost your productivity whether you're writing, researching, studying, or just exploring. MC can help you analyze PDF/Word docs, query image selections, take instant notes, create flashcards, diagrams, and even generate images! Why we built this: We believe accessing the power of AI shouldn't disrupt your workflow. It should feel like a natural extension of your thoughts, seamlessly integrated into how you already use your Mac. That's the "Mighty" in Mighty Cursor – [...] Subscribe

A few things people usually ask: - Every participant is AI. There are no humans on your calls. - Every call is transcribed, can be summarised into key points and action items, and can be rejoined later with the same cast. - You can tap any agent mid call and rewrite their name, role, or personality. - Android is live today. iOS is built and waiting on submission. Every new account gets a free minute, no card. After that it is monthly minute bundles starting at $4.99. Bring an idea, decision or question and two to eight AI voices talk it through with you on a live voice call: a host, a skeptic, specialists, or models you pick like Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok. They answer each other, push back, and stop the moment you speak. Use it as an AI council or board of advisors, to pressure-test a pitch, or to practise a panel interview. Every call ends with a summary, action items and a shareable transcript. Three free minutes per account, no card.

 More [...] Hi Product Hunt, I am Tash, the maker. AI Group Call started with a small frustration. I could ask one chatbot for advice, but the thing I actually wanted was the room: the meeting where a skeptic pokes a hole in your pitch, a strategist reframes it, and someone plays the customer who has to sign off. So I built the room. You type a goal, and a few seconds later you are in a live voice call with six AI participants cast for that specific goal, each with a name, a role, and a personality. They speak one at a time, build on and disagree with each other, and go quiet the moment you start talking. That last part was by far the hardest bit.
